# flac-lite frame-RUN golden vectors -- GENERATED
# DO NOT EDIT BY HAND.  Regenerate with:  scripts/gen_frame_vectors.sh
# Generator + independent walk: scripts/frame_vectors.py (emit_runs)
# Source streams: scripts/frame_vectors.py synth (integer-exact, no RNG)
# Encoder: flac 1.5.0
#
# Ground truth for step 3f part 2's `decode_frame`: whole 2-frame runs
# (256 + 100 samples @ -b 256; the 100 tail forces the uncommon 8-bit
# blocksize form). `frame_hex` rows are raw libFLAC frames IN STREAM
# ORDER, each covering its frame THROUGH the footer (padding +
# CRC-16) to the next frame's first byte -- concatenating the rows in
# order reproduces the contiguous frame region byte-exactly, so a
# single BitReader can chain frame N -> frame N+1 exactly as a real
# decode loop does; `frame_blocksize` rows pair with them by position.
# `side_slot` names the decorrelated slot coded at bps + 1 (none/0/1)
# -- step 3f part 1's measured seam, table-driven so the Rust side
# reads it, never re-derives it. `side_width_sensitive` says whether
# that seam is OBSERVABLE on this run's side slot (none/true/false),
# computed from the walk's own kind/order: FIXED-0 subframes never
# consult frame bps (no warm-up reads, width-independent Rice codewords,
# pad by the wasted field), so left/side and side/right -- whose tiny
# quantized-noise sides measure as FIXED-0 wasted 4 -- carry an inert
# seam (false); mid/side's side is LPC-3 on frame 0, so its warm-up
# reads make the seam load-bearing (true). The Rust suite's negative
# control demands divergence exactly where the flag says true, and
# demands width-INvariance where it says false -- the flag is checked,
# not trusted.
# Two ground-truth layers, both whole-stream: `slot_stored_N` is slot
# N's DECODED subframe samples (on decorrelated runs the side slot
# holds L-R, the mid slot (L+R)>>1) -- derived from pcm_left/pcm_right
# by the encoder-side formulas and re-checked at generation time
# against each subframe's own warm-up/verbatim/constant fields by the
# independent Bits walk (an encoder-side reading of the spec,
# independent of the crate's decoder-side recovery). pcm_left/
# pcm_right are the reference DECODER (flac -d) whole-stream PCM
# de-interleaved -- always the TRUE L/R, even where the subframe
# holds a stored value; a full frame decode (decorrelate included)
# must match them on every vector.
# Generation-time invariants (fail-closed, walk_stream_runs): blocksizes
# [256, 100] with the tail at the uncommon 8-bit code; uniform channel
# census == the label; side slot walked at bps+1; per-frame footer gap
# landing exactly on the next frame offset; warm-up == stored >>
# wasted; verbatim body == stored block; constant body == one value
# << wasted. A libFLAC upgrade that changes any mode choice refuses to
# write this file.
